content_manifest.bio_intro: Rory Attwell is a London-based music producer, film composer, and sound designer. Founder of Lightship95 — a renowned analog-focused recording studio permanently moored aboard a 1930s lightship in Trinity Buoy Wharf, London E14.
content_manifest.secondary_background: Formerly of influential UK band Test Icicles; released solo work under Warm Brains ('Old Volcanoes', 2011). Has produced, engineered, or mixed hundreds of records including work for The Vaccines, Palma Violets, Yuck, Veronica Falls, Male Bonding, and S.C.U.M.

lightship_specs.name: Lightship 95 Studio
lightship_specs.location: Trinity Buoy Wharf, River Thames, London E14 0JY
features: Custom analog tracking room suspended inside a 1930s steel lightship hull
Classic analog console & vintage outboard gear (Neve, Calrec, UREI, Tape Delay)
Spacious live drum tracking hall with natural river reflections & organic acoustic warmth
Panoramic views of the Thames and historic lighthouse peninsula

layout_sections.style: Sticky thin header with optical backdrop blur, monogram logo mark, anchor links ('Work', 'Lightship 95', 'About', 'Contact'), and quick 'Request Showreel' mailto button.

Asymmetric editorial spread with staggered line-by-line masked text reveal ('RORY ATTWELL — MUSIC PRODUCER & FILM COMPOSER'), subtle floating studio photo card, sound wave micro-viz trigger, and direct quick links.
Ultra-slow editorial scrolling ribbon in warm low-contrast serif text: 'FILM SCORES • RECORD PRODUCTION • SOUND DESIGN • LIGHTSHIP 95 LONDON • SXSW SELECTION • ANALOG MIXING'.
Large serif statement block highlighting scoring + sound design + Lightship95 setup. Interactive focus drawer to toggle producer/composer highlight stats.

Filterable credit list with category pills ('All', 'Film Score', 'Record Production', 'Sound Design & Mix', 'Live & TV'), search bar, expandable detail drawers, hover spotlight image previews, and direct outgoing links.
Split-screen section featuring ship photography, custom spec drawer, Trinity Buoy Wharf coordinates, and analog equipment list highlight.
Clean two-column historical section detailing Test Icicles history, Warm Brains solo LP, and notable production roster (The Vaccines, Yuck, Veronica Falls, Male Bonding).
Dark charcoal ground (#141312) contrast shift with large statement text 'Let's create the sound', prominent 'Request Showreel' action button, direct copyable email widget, and social links.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete single-page portfolio in `/app/frontend/src/App.js` or component modules imported into `App.js`.
DO NOT use raw transparent header or generic blue gradients. Stick to the Warm Bone (#FBF9F5) paper editorial look.

Include all user explicit details, specifically: 'The Skin Will Tell You' SXSW London short film score/sound design, Palma Violets #11 debut LP, Body of Water, How to Talk to Girls at Parties, The End of the F***ing World, and Lightship95 studio.
Implement Sonner toast for interactive feedback when clicking 'Copy Email' or 'Request Showreel'.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to key buttons, nav links, filters, and credit items for automated test verification.
Ensure total responsiveness from 320px mobile up to 4K desktop screens.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain Bootstrap columns.
Use generous padding (py-16 md:py-28) between sections for luxurious editorial breathing room.
All interactive elements must have visible focus/hover states and proper data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide icons for high quality iconography.
